own_review.kind: Own review of requirements, correctness, safety, compatibility and complexity; independent reviews supplement it

review.requirements: Retain primary and close failures, consume each native ownership once, return no data after failed close, preserve absence/cancellation and optional-digest backup behavior.
reviewed: Four production files and four tests; Windows/POSIX ownership transitions, deferred cleanup, immediate consumers and typed error projection.
current transfers to the newly opened child before closing its previous parent. Failure does not leave the consumed numeric parent owned by deferred cleanup.
close failures join after the primary cause and zero/discard any result bytes. Native missing may remain discoverable diagnostically without authorizing the two absence-dependent consumers.
Per-call private seams introduce neither a public API nor a global mutable hook. Existing production functions supply native operations and the original reader.
Native test resources are owned fixtures; injected failures do not repeat an OS close on a potentially reused numeric identity. No Task Scheduler or installed product call is selected.

finding_fixed_before_qualification.condition: A direct StateFileReadError has a composite Cause containing native absence and another failure.
finding_fixed_before_qualification.consequence: A broad errors.Is predicate would let compensation or consumer logic treat an incomplete read as clean absence.
finding_fixed_before_qualification.fix: Require a direct native missing error at an allowed open operation and add a distinguishing nested-Cause regression.

review.compatibility: Ordinary errors.Is/As behavior is retained. Direct StateFileReadError.Is(os.ErrNotExist) now also recognizes the POSIX native missing case; this small method-level nuance is disclosed.
review.qualification: Frozen source858 + 13 overlays; reader control/candidate, six phases, full build/vet and Linux compile-only have completed. Published-tree equality requires separate readback.
remaining: external review of the exact published commit

global_limits: Qualification compositions are explicit overlays, not an assertion that an entire standalone branch passed all acceptance gates.
No full Go test suite, installed product, real Scheduler action, installation, manual CI or paid/quota reviewer was executed.
Direct-child settlement and available command-line observations do not constitute an atomic whole-process-tree guarantee.
